# Protect, Optimize, and Scale Your Infrastructure for AI

Confidently meet the demands of AI with solutions that secure and deliver your mission-critical
applications and networks

[ Explore Solutions ][137]

### Purpose-built Solutions

## Build secure, high‑performance AI‑ready infrastructure

A10 keeps your applications, networks, cloud services, and data centers running fast, secure,
and reliable.

Whether you’re an enterprise or a service provider, get the protection, performance, and centralized
management you need to deliver consistent connectivity without complexity.

[Purpose-built Solutions][Purpose-built Solutions]

### Security Solutions

#### Protect your business from emerging security threats

With AI changing how applications connect and communicate, traffic patterns are becoming
increasingly unpredictable and introducing risks like DDoS attacks, API abuse, inference
manipulation, and shadow AI.

A10 Networks delivers comprehensive protection across network and application layers and APIs,
defending against DDoS attacks, bots, infiltration, exfiltration, prompt injection, and more.

[ Protect Your Apps & Networks ][138]
[Security Solutions][Security Solutions]

### Infrastructure Solutions

#### Ensure ultra-low latency performance for mission-critical AI applications

Modern applications and AI workloads must operate flawlessly across on-prem, cloud, and edge
environments.

A10 Networks provides industry-leading performance, low latency and GPU-aware load balancing. Built
on a unified architecture with flexible licensing, A10 solutions ensure your mission-critical apps
are fast, secure, and available.

[ Optimize & Scale Your Infrastructure ][139]
[Infrastructure Solutions][Infrastructure Solutions]

### Centralized Management & Automation Solutions

#### Simplify operations across complex environments

Managing infrastructure across multiple clouds is becoming increasingly complex, especially for
AI‑enabled apps that demand precise capacity planning and prompt scaling.

### Purpose-built Solutions

## Build secure, high‑performance AI‑ready infrastructure

A10 keeps your applications, networks, cloud services, and data centers running fast, secure,
and reliable.

Whether you’re an enterprise or a service provider, get the protection, performance, and centralized
management you need to deliver consistent connectivity without complexity.

[Purpose-built Solutions][Purpose-built Solutions]

### Security Solutions

#### Protect your business from emerging security threats

With AI changing how applications connect and communicate, traffic patterns are becoming
increasingly unpredictable and introducing risks like DDoS attacks, API abuse, inference
manipulation, and shadow AI.

A10 Networks delivers comprehensive protection across network and application layers and APIs,
defending against DDoS attacks, bots, infiltration, exfiltration, prompt injection, and more.

### Infrastructure Solutions

#### Ensure ultra-low latency performance for mission-critical AI applications

Modern applications and AI workloads must operate flawlessly across on-prem, cloud, and edge
environments.

A10 Networks provides industry-leading performance, low latency and GPU-aware load balancing. Built
on a unified architecture with flexible licensing, A10 solutions ensure your mission-critical apps
are fast, secure, and available.

development with modern frameworks.

for exceptional digital experiences.

# System Integration & Cybersecurity for Modern Organizations

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi membantu Anda mengintegrasikan infrastruktur TI dan mengamankan aset
digital—mulai dari desain arsitektur, implementasi, hingga operasi keamanan. Secure your own future.

[ Konsultasi ][7] [ Lihat Layanan ][8]

## About Us

### Who We Are

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,

## About Us

PT. Arahan Bahtera Teknologi adalah perusahaan **System Integrator** dan **Cybersecurity Services**
yang membantu organisasi merancang, mengintegrasikan, dan mengamankan ekosistem TI. Kami
menggabungkan keahlian infrastruktur (network, server, cloud) dengan praktik keamanan (assessment,
hardening, monitoring, incident response) agar sistem berjalan **stabil**, **terukur**, dan

simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

# INS Provides Intelligent Network Solutions

INS provides network solutions to maximise the uptime of communication systems by creating
redundancy, maintaining, protecting and monitoring the physical layer of the system.

Our products and services are appropriate for a wide range of industries including fire protection,
intrusion, access control, petrochemical, industrial, marine and mining industries.

[ Products ][47]
[ Our Clients ][48]
[logo]
[=""]

## What Makes INS Unique?

INS has a proactive network maintenance approach with its range of software products which allows
for either on-site or remote monitoring of a network.

[ About Us ][49]

## Why Use INS?

INS products make fault detection easy, the way our products function, providing visual diagnostic
display of information which was previously invisible and inaccessible.

[ Get In Touch ][50]

## Featured Products

INS003-P

#### INS003-P

Passive Dual Channel Optic Fibre Converter / Hybrid Medium network communication equipment: (Dual
CIE ports with 2.5 kV isolation)

#### Features

Used to provide an optic fibre communication bus for CIE equipment with RS-485 communication
interfaces.

[ Datasheet][51]
INS007

#### INS007

RS-485 Transient Suppression Module with 2.5kV isolation

#### Features

A module designed to introduce protection against Electrostatic Discharge, Electrical Fast Transient
and Slow High Energy Voltage Surge.

[Datasheet][52]
[ See All Products ][53]

[Read Full >][55]

“Since the installation of the Instance equipment, the network has perform exceptionally well, with

- Simon Smith,  Mondelez Bournville site – Home of Cadbury, United Kingdom

## Queens University Hospital

“The fire alarm network at the Queen’s Medical Centre in Nottingham consists of 77 panels which use
a bespoke RS-485 network card array, designed from the ground up for large complex fire alarm
networks. After 19 years’ service spares for this network card were becoming unavailable and also
the fire alarm network was suffering frequent breakdowns due to a combination of cables perishing
with age, mechanical damage to cables and also increased electrical and electronic noise. INS
Technologies were approached to replace the obsolete network card with a modern data network
solution, the DNA card. The DNA Cards were installed over a four-week period and have resulted in a
more stable and resilient fire alarm network, and the network is currently performing well. The DNA
Cards have also filtered out the external influences allowing for a more efficient data flow. They
have also identified issues with existing copper cables that require replacing and this will form
part of an ongoing refurbishment programme.”

***– Matthew Grimshaw, ***
***Estates Capital Project Manager, ***
***Nottingham University Hospitals Trust***

## Queens University Hospital

“The fire alarm network at the Queen’s Medical Centre in Nottingham consists of 77 panels which use
a bespoke RS-485 network card array, designed from the ground up for large complex fire alarm
networks. After 19 years’ service spares for this network card were becoming unavailable and also
the fire alarm network was suffering frequent breakdowns due to a combination of cables perishing
with age, mechanical damage to cables and also increased electrical and electronic noise. INS
Technologies were approached to replace the obsolete network card with a modern data network
solution, the DNA card. The DNA Cards were installed over a four-week period and have resulted in a
more stable and resilient fire alarm network, and the network is currently performing well. The DNA
Cards have also filtered out the external influences allowing for a more efficient data flow. They
have also identified issues with existing copper cables that require replacing and this will form
part of an ongoing refurbishment programme.”

***– Matthew Grimshaw, ***
***Estates Capital Project Manager, ***
***Nottingham University Hospitals Trust***

legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

## How Snic Helps Manufacturers Modernize Operations

Manufacturers rely on multiple systems such as ERP, PLM, MES, APS, and files across multiple shared
folders.

Integrating data across these systems is often the biggest challenge in digital manufacturing
initiatives.

Snic Solutions helps manufacturers address this challenge through a combination of **industry
platforms and our own data technology.**

### **Factory Thread**

Our operational data platform that connects manufacturing data across ERP systems, spreadsheets, and
legacy applications.

### **Siemens Opcenter**

Industry-leading manufacturing applications including MES, APS, and LIMS that digitize operations.

### **Snic Solutions**

Implementation and integration experts with over 18 years of experience deploying manufacturing
systems globally.

## What is SpiderFoot

SpiderFoot is a free, open-source intelligence (OSINT) software written in Python 3. This automation
tool collects, analyzes, and connects data from hundreds of sources — helping security
professionals, penetration testers, and analysts understand what information is publicly available
about a given target.

You can use SpiderFoot to gather intelligence on an IP address, domain name, hostname, ASN, subnet,
email address, or even a person’s name. Being completely free and open source, it supports both
offensive reconnaissance (for red teaming and penetration testing) and defensive reconnaissance (to
identify exposed information about your own infrastructure).

## How SpiderFoot Works

SpiderFoot simplifies and automates the entire reconnaissance and intelligence-gathering process.
Instead of manually searching dozens of data sources, SpiderFoot handles everything through a
structured, automated workflow. Here’s how it works:

### Define Your Target

Begin by entering the asset or identifier you want to investigate. This can be a domain name, IP
address, email address, ASN, hostname, network range, or any other data point. SpiderFoot uses this
target as the foundation for gathering all related intelligence.

### Select Modules

SpiderFoot comes with a large library of modules, each designed to gather a specific type of data.
You can choose modules such as WHOIS lookups, DNS record discovery, Shodan scanning, breach database
checks like Have I Been Pwned, social media intelligence, geolocation data, IP reputation services,
and many more.
You have full control over which modules to run, allowing you to tailor the scan to your exact
objectives.

### Scan & Analyze

Once your modules are selected, SpiderFoot automatically performs the entire intelligence-gathering
process.
It collects, correlates, and organizes information into a clear and structured format. After the
scan is complete, you can:
* Review detailed results
* Filter data to focus on specific findings
* Visualize relationships between data points
* Identify patterns or potential risks
* Export reports for documentation or further investigation

SpiderFoot centralizes all intelligence in one place, making complex data easy to explore and
understand.

### Automated Intelligence

Every step — from querying data sources to connecting related findings — is fully automated. This
eliminates hours of manual OSINT work and significantly increases the depth, accuracy, and speed of
your reconnaissance.
SpiderFoot ensures you discover more information, in less time, with far greater consistency than
traditional manual methods.

## What You Need to Get Started

SpiderFoot works on every major platform. Whether you want SpiderFoot for Windows, for Mac, or for
Linux, setup takes only a few minutes. You can download SpiderFoot for Windows and Mac directly, run
it on Linux, or even access it from Android through a remote browser — giving you full flexibility
on any device.

## Basic Setup
* Python 3.7 (a programming language)
* 2GB RAM (like your phone's memory)
* 1GB storage space (a few songs worth)
* Works on Windows, Mac, or Linux computers
* Internet connection (to search the web)

## Best Experience
* Python 3.9 or newer version
* 4GB+ RAM (more = faster!)
* 5GB+ storage (to save lots of searches)
* Linux computer (Ubuntu 20.04 or newer)
* Fast internet (finds stuff quicker!)
